notes.title: Patch 0.5.0
notes.notes:
Drafting
 After each round instead of getting a reward card/relic/consumable. You get money and get to go to the merchant and can buy whatever you want
Minions
 instead of having an RNG set of minions, we can now have a party of up to 4 different minions
Energy 
 To simplify the numbers, energy has been reduced down to 5 (down from 10) , and all cards/minions have been rebalanced to reflect this. This simplifies scrapping and spirit exchange to gaining 1 as opposed to 3.
Town/Meta Progression
In order to focus on and polish the core game, we have decided to remove the town-building aspect of the game. And have limited the meta progression down to unlocking new starting minions (for now), we may add  more later, but we felt that having too much meta progression makes the game significantly less replayable, and much much harder to balance. Stat based meta progression has been shown to make many games much more of a grind rather than a super replayable experience, we'd rather the game be just as fun each time, but you can unlock new items and features.
Eternal Cards
 Cards that can give you a passive ability for the rest of a match. (Ex: Whenever you gain armor, deal 1 burn to all enemies)
Relics: We have now capped relics to 4 and have made the majority of relics more powerful to reflect this change. This makes it easier to keep track of all the passives you have going within a run.
Consumables
 Instead of having consumables in your inventory. Consumables are now used right when you acquire them, but many of them have permanent stat buffs ( Ex: increases the number of cards you draw per turn)
Special Ability
Special ability has been removed to make room for some of the future changes of this game. We felt that it was cluttering up the UI.

Many polishes and balance changes
Nicer map, hand-crafted backgrounds, cleaner, more consistent UI, and plenty of other changes.

notes.title: PATCH 0.3.0 - The minion art update
notes.notes:
Patch notes: 0.3.0



BALANCE CHANGES:

 MAJOR-All Special abilities have been buffed
 MAJOR-Start of turn card draw reduced to 2 cards (there was never a point where running out of cards was an issue)
 Many of the cards that draw cards have been buffed to counteract this change as well
 Starting deck starts with 2 different cards, nurture and study
 Add more on scrap effects on some cards
 10+ new cards

Minions and Enemies

 Almost all minions have been replaced artistically and many have been readjusted
 The x2 intention for enemies now targets the player AND a minion instead of attacking the player twice

Artifacts:

 New: Wood, Eggnog, nigiri
 Strawberry: 1st card is played twice, and energy is reduced by 2 at start of combat


Bugs

 Fixed freeze on refresh hand bug
 Fixed chance to not have leave button after an encounter

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.1 - MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Patch notes: 0.2.1
CONTENT:
HEROIC MODE- Completing the first zone unlocks a much more difficult mode that gains you double the gold
SPECIAL ABILITIES - Each run nets you one of (currently) 8 unique SPECIAL abilities
6 new minions: Fox, Pirate Boar,Mallard,Wolfhound, Vine,Piggy Bank

 New Talent- Rebirth
 25+ New cards

New Mechanics:
 Invoke- get a minion to take its move
 Divine- This card generates 50% more spirit 

GAME UPDATES:

 Leveling- You now have a basic level which determines which cards/relics/consumables and talents are available to you,
 Cards/Artifacts/Consumables now require resource requirements in order to purchase them
 Polished multiple UI elements
 Added search bar to inventory
 Strength has been renamed to Rage
 Life Cap removed


BUG FIXES:
Fixed Potential for tutorial to not show slides at the beginning
Fixed summoning minions that cost more than amount
